usedFor: Zoom is where the call happens and Calendly handles what comes next. When “When a meeting ends” fires in Zoom, “Create Scheduling Link” can produce a booking link for the follow-up.

bestTemplate.name: “When a meeting ends” in Zoom, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: Ending is the natural moment to offer a follow-up slot, and the action creates a booking link you can pass on.

watchOut: “When a participant joins a meeting” also reaches this action, which would make a link per join. Use “When a meeting ends” to get one link per meeting.
